name: devops
description: Skills and agents for CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure

skills.name: skeletor-animation
skills.description: Skeletor animations use React Native's built-in Animated API (never Reanimated), default native true, return useRef(create...).current for ref stability, and expose forward/backward/reset.

skills.name: skeletor-context-defaults
skills.description: Skeletor component defaults resolve from useSkeletor(); new global defaults go in SkeletorConfig + SkeletorDefaults; props always win over context; no hardcoded magic values in component bodies.

skills.name: skeletor-spacing
skills.description: Skeletor spacing props (margins/paddings/gap) are polymorphic — scalar, tuple, four-side tuple, or object — and must normalize through the existing normalize-* helpers, never hand-rolled shorthand.

skills.name: skeletor-structure
skills.description: Every skeletor component gets its own folder with an index.ts barrel, internal elements get a displayName, and all cross-module imports are relative — never bare utils/models/components/hooks.

skills.name: skeletor-style-props
skills.description: Skeletor primitives accept a typed style-prop intersection, convert via extractSkeletorStyleProperties + memoizeStyle, and apply styles in canonical order — never StyleSheet.create in a body.

skills.name: skeletor-types
skills.description: Derive skeletor types via template-literal/mapped/Extract over RN types, not hand-maintained unions; keep Font ambient; no any without a biome-ignore, no as without a comment.

skills.name: api-error-handling
skills.description: Use structured error responses and never leak internal details.

skills.name: llm-package-hallucination
skills.description: Verify every LLM-suggested dependency exists in the registry before installing — hallucinated package names are a real supply-chain attack surface (slopsquatting).

skills.name: never-read-env
skills.description: Never read .env files directly in code.

skills.name: security-secrets
skills.description: Never hardcode secrets, tokens, or credentials in source code.

skills.name: coverage-meaningful-not-vanity
skills.description: Assert observable behavior and edge cases; never write tests that execute code without asserting anything

skills.name: flaky-test-policy
skills.description: Quarantine-then-fix flaky tests; a retried test is a tracked bug, not a pass

skills.name: mocking-boundaries
skills.description: Mock at I/O and network boundaries only; never mock the unit under test; prefer fakes over deep mock chains

skills.name: test-data-builders
skills.description: Use factory or builder functions for test fixtures; never scatter inline object literals across the test suite

skills.name: test-determinism
skills.description: Avoid timing-based, random, and wall-clock assertions; use fake timers and frozen clocks instead

skills.name: test-isolation
skills.description: Each test must set up and tear down its own state; never rely on execution order or shared mutable state

skills.name: test-naming
skills.description: Name tests as "it does X when Y" — describe the behavior under a condition, not the implementation

skills.name: git-move
skills.description: Use git mv for tracked files to preserve history.

skills.name: git-workflow
skills.description: Branch protection, branch naming, and PR workflow rules.

skills.name: pre-commit-checks
skills.description: Run formatter, linter, and build checks before every commit.

skills.name: docs-parity
skills.description: Keep documentation in sync with every user-facing change.

skills.name: mermaid-diagrams
skills.description: Use Mermaid diagrams instead of ASCII art.

skills.name: post-edit-diagnostics
skills.description: Run diagnostics and formatter after editing code files.

skills.name: ansible-conventions
skills.description: Follow Ansible best practices for idempotent, maintainable infrastructure automation.

skills.name: ci-workflow-conventions
skills.description: Secure CI/CD workflows with minimal permissions, pinned actions, and OIDC authentication.

skills.name: container-image-pinning
skills.description: Pin container image versions to prevent unexpected breaking changes.

skills.name: docker-best-practices
skills.description: Follow container best practices for secure, efficient Docker images.

skills.name: helm-conventions
skills.description: Write safe, reusable Helm charts with secure defaults and consistent values structure.

skills.name: idempotency
skills.description: Every operation — task, script, or deployment — must be safe to re-run without side effects.

skills.name: jinja2-templates
skills.description: Write safe, readable Jinja2 templates for Ansible and configuration generation.

skills.name: kubernetes-manifests
skills.description: Write safe, production-grade Kubernetes manifests with resource limits, health checks, and security context.

skills.name: runbook-discipline
skills.description: Keep operational runbooks and ADRs accurate and commit them alongside the changes they document.

skills.name: shell-script-standards
skills.description: Write safe, portable shell scripts with error handling and clear control flow.

skills.name: terraform-conventions
skills.description: Follow Terraform module structure and naming conventions.

skills.name: accessible-forms
skills.description: Every form control must have a programmatic label, clear error identification, and grouped fields where appropriate

skills.name: aria-only-when-needed
skills.description: ARIA is a fallback for when native HTML falls short — never add redundant or conflicting roles

skills.name: color-contrast
skills.description: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios; never use color as the only visual signal

skills.name: focus-management
skills.description: Provide visible focus indicators; move focus intentionally on route change and dialog open/close

skills.name: keyboard-navigation
skills.description: All interactive elements must be reachable and operable by keyboard alone; no keyboard traps

skills.name: reduced-motion
skills.description: Honor prefers-reduced-motion; never use motion as the sole affordance for a state change

skills.name: semantic-html
skills.description: Prefer native HTML elements over div+role soup; semantic elements are accessible by default

skills.name: text-alternatives
skills.description: Provide descriptive alt text for meaningful images; empty alt for decorative; alternatives for icons and media

skills.name: workspace-hygiene
skills.description: Audits the workspace before a commit or PR — confirms diff scope, flags stray console.log/debugger/scratch files and secrets, checks atomic commits. Use after a refactor or before opening a PR.

skills.name: config-echo
skills.description: Verifies bluetemberg config (rules, agents, skills) is loaded in the session by recalling from context and cross-referencing disk. Use after `bluetemberg sync` or when a rule seems ignored.

skills.name: stack-change-review
skills.description: Reviews high-blast-radius infra diffs (docker-compose, Ansible group_vars, Terraform, k8s, .env) — port, volume, image, and env risks. Use when reviewing changes to deployed infrastructure.

skills.name: session-retrospective
skills.description: Audits a Claude Code session — deterministic jq analysis of token spend and tool usage, then a judged retrospective in .claude/retrospectives/. Use after a task or when a session felt expensive.

skills.name: security-audit
skills.description: Triages code security findings by severity with detection steps for secrets, injection, auth, input, and dependency risks. Use when reviewing changes pre-deploy or touching auth, input, or uploads.

skills.name: rollback-plan
skills.description: Require and validate a tested rollback plan before merging production deploy, Kubernetes/Terraform, schema-migration, or version-bump PRs. Adds a complexity tier tree, data-loss check, PR template.

skills.name: payload-cache-revalidation
skills.description: Standardizes Next.js + Payload cache revalidation — a cacheTags source of truth, per-locale vs locale-agnostic tags, hooks per cached collection. Use when editing unstable_cache or revalidation hooks.

skills.name: k6-load-testing
skills.description: Standardizes k6 load tests — scenario taxonomy, shared config/requests libs, baseline-driven p95 thresholds, __ENV parametrization, and a CI smoke gate. Use when writing or editing k6 scripts.

skills.name: infrastructure-drift-check
skills.description: Detects infrastructure drift before merging IaC changes by diffing declared vs deployed state. Use when reviewing or merging Terraform .tf, Ansible, Kubernetes manifests, Helm, or Compose PRs.

skills.name: docs-upkeep
skills.description: Updates affected docs in the same task as code or workflow changes — README, API docs, CLI --help, config, wiki. Use when renaming endpoints, adding flags/config, or fixing stale references.

skills.name: create-skill
skills.description: Scaffold a new bluetemberg skill to the deep-skill standard — Protocol, decision trees, BAD/GOOD examples, and a completion checklist.

skills.name: create-rule
skills.description: Scaffold a new bluetemberg rule in the correct format — frontmatter, a Why/Rules/BAD-GOOD/config/gotchas body, and sync.

skills.name: create-pack
skills.description: Scaffold a whole new bluetemberg pack — package.json metadata, llm/ layout, catalog registration, and validation.

skills.name: create-agent
skills.description: Scaffold a new bluetemberg agent in the correct format — frontmatter with scoped tools, responsibilities, constraints, and sync.

skills.name: ci-cd-best-practices
skills.description: Audits CI/CD pipeline config (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for SHA pinning, dep caching, deploy gates, parallelism, OIDC. Use when adding or editing workflow files or fixing slow/flaky pipelines.

agents.name: sre-specialist
agents.description: Reviews production reliability — SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, alerts, runbooks, post-mortems. Use proactively for on-call, observability, or incident-readiness review, not code or security audits.

agents.name: session-auditor
agents.description: Audits a Claude Code session transcript for token spend and harness-usage quality — wasted calls, missed delegation, cache misses — and writes a graded retrospective. Use after a session ends.

agents.name: security-specialist
agents.description: Audits code for OWASP Top 10 vulns, injection, broken auth/access control, secrets exposure, and dependency/supply-chain CVEs. MUST BE USED for deep security review. Reports findings, does not edit.

agents.name: payload-specialist
agents.description: Builds and reviews Payload CMS schemas — collections, globals, blocks, fields, hooks, access, Lexical, plugins, migrations, payload-types. Use proactively for payload.config work. Not generic APIs.

agents.name: kubernetes-specialist
agents.description: Writes and reviews Kubernetes manifests, Helm charts, Kustomize overlays — RBAC, probes, resources, security contexts, autoscaling, zero-downtime rollouts. Use proactively when editing k8s YAML.

agents.name: infrastructure-specialist
agents.description: Maintains build tooling, Dockerfiles, Compose, and dependency manifests/lockfiles for reproducible, secure builds. Use proactively when editing Dockerfile, docker-compose, package.json, or lockfiles.

agents.name: docs-maintainer
agents.description: Updates and audits documentation (README, runbooks, API docs, Mermaid diagrams) to match code, config, and workflow changes. Use proactively after behavior, CLI, API, or schema changes.

agents.name: devops-specialist
agents.description: Designs and optimizes CI/CD pipelines, Docker images, Terraform IaC, deploy safety, and shell scripts. Use proactively when editing .github/workflows, Dockerfile, terraform/, or Makefile.

agents.name: ansible-specialist
agents.description: Writes, reviews, and lints Ansible roles, playbooks, and Jinja2 templates for idempotent infra automation. Use proactively when editing anything under roles/, playbooks, ansible.cfg, or inventory.
